text:
jess-partnerships: Hey team — prepping cost model inputs from VoltCloud. They sent regional spot eviction windows + tiered reserved credits. Need quick alignment on how to map this into the model.

mike-finance: quick q — do they give guaranteed minimum reserved capacity by region or just commit $?

jess-partnerships: They have a 3-tier commit: 1) 6mo min at 40% off, 2) 12mo at 55% off, 3) 24mo at 65% off. But reserves are regional: eu-west has a 15% carveout for enterprise customers (can't be re-allocated).

tom-eng: important: what are their spot preemption windows? affects tail latency model + SLO penalties.

jess-partnerships: Spot eviction notes: typical 1-3min churn, but they annotated scheduled-maintenance windows 0100-0300 UTC where preemptions spike (~30% higher). Also they offer spot floor pricing (min price) and a spot-hold buffer for 15% of capacity at +10% price.

lina-prod: hmm — marketplace listing requires we model both the spot floor and the scheduled spike so we can set fallback routing. Do we have a CSV spec for their SKU mapping?

sara-ops: they attached a CSV sample, but headers differ from our schema. here's the snippet they sent:
```
region,sku,commit_term_months,reserved_discount,spot_floor_usd/hour,scheduled_spike_window,carveout_flag
eu-west,vvolt-a100-80gb,12,0.55,1.10,0100-0300,enterprise
us-west,vvolt-a100-80gb,6,0.40,0.95,,
asia-southeast,vvolt-a100-80gb,24,0.65,1.25,0200-0400,
```

mike-finance: ok. For cost model mapping: reserved_discount should be applied to on-demand list price, spot_floor goes into worst-case spot cost, scheduled_spike -> increase preemption probability by factor 1.3. For carveout_flag we treat that capacity as non-shareable; set available_pool -= carveout.

tom-eng: one more: how do they bill rounding and refunds on preemptions? Does marketplace give credits or prorated refunds?

jess-partnerships: They offer SLA credits for sustained unavailability > 1h on reserved pools (credit = 5% monthly fee per extra hour up to 48h). For spot, they only provide short-term eviction logs; no credits. Marketplace listing fee applies to reserved commits (3% of committed spend monthly).

lina-prod: action items: 1) eng: add scheduled_spike multiplier into preemption model (tom), 2) finance: include marketplace fee and carveout adjustments (mike), 3) partnerships: request normalized CSV with our headers + per-sku latency premium (jess). Can supply-bot add a reminder to ping VoltCloud for normalized file?

supply-bot: Reminder set: ping @voltcloud-rep in 48h for 'normalized_cost_csv' and 'latency_premium_per_sku'. :bell:

mike-finance: thanks — I'll prototype a sensitivity run comparing 6mo vs 24mo commits with and without carveouts. will share numbers tomorrow.

jess-partnerships: Great. If anyone is parsing the CSV, note reserved_discount is a fraction (0.55 => 55% off). Our importer expects percent; parser will need to convert.

tom-eng: will add a unit test for parser, and a small sim for scheduled_spike windows.

lina-prod: tagging @security — any PII/contract issues before we surface commit terms publicly in marketplace docs?

jess-partnerships: short answer: none on the fields above, but legal will review commits. I'll loop them in after we get normalized CSV.

mike-finance: cool, thanks all :thumbsup:
